apps.name: HomeRoll

apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone and iPad app for your own Immich server that looks and feels like Apple Photos: library with years, months and days, collections, memories, people, albums, folders, search, editing and automatic backup.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Swipe down like Photos, zoom in videos

- **Swipe down to close** (#63): only the photo moves now, the grid already shows behind it and its tile stays empty until the photo lands there. Neighbouring photos no longer slide in while swiping.
- **Pinch to zoom in videos** (#64), with panning and double tap, like photos.
- **Folder covers** (#60) stay in place instead of reloading every time you open Collections, also after restarting the app.

## Backup: next item gets ready while one uploads

- **Faster backup on slow or distant connections**: with the app open, the next photo or video is already prepared (copied, checked with your server) while the current one uploads, so the line no longer sits idle between items. Over a long-distance VPN this more than doubled the speed in testing. At most one video is handled at a time, and in the background it's still one item after the other.
- Each tile that's uploading shows its own progress ring.

## Much faster backup while the app is open

- **Uploads no longer crawl**: with the app open, every upload still went through iOS's background transfer, which iOS can throttle a lot. On a slow, long-distance connection (abroad over a VPN) it managed about 0.1 Mbit/s all night with the app open and the screen on. Now the app uploads directly while it's open, as fast as Safari on the same connection (15–20× faster in that case). The background transfer is only used when the app runs in the background.
- **Screen stays on while backing up** when the app is open and the phone is plugged in, so a big backup doesn't stop at auto-lock. On battery, auto-lock works as usual.

## Swipe down like Photos, folders fixed

- **Closing the photo viewer** (#59): pinch-to-close is gone, so zooming back out never closes the photo. Swipe down is new: only the photo follows your finger and shrinks while the bars and background fade, release to close or let go early and it springs back.
- **Folders no longer show up empty** (#60): if loading a folder failed on the phone, the app kept it empty until the next start. It now retries and loads fewer folders at once.

## Zoom and backup fixes

- **Zooming back out no longer closes the photo** (#58): while a photo is zoomed, the pinch-to-close and swipe-down gestures are paused, so pinching out stays in the viewer. Swiping to the next photo resets the zoom, like Photos.
- **Backup no longer stops by itself**: a short background wake-up from iOS could end a backup that was running with the app open after about 20 seconds, so it looked stuck. Fixed.
- **Hang and crash reports** from iOS are now kept on the device, which helps track down stutters.
